rollback.sql: UPDATE incomes i SET income_date = make_date( extract(year from i.income_date)::int, extract(month from i.income_date)::int, least(s.pay_business_day, extract(day from (date_trunc('month', i.income_date) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))::int)) FROM income_sources s WHERE i.source_id = s.id AND i.income_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date;
